literature_notes: ORAI3 is a 4-TM channel with both termini intracellular (N-term: 1–64; C-term: 265–295) and two extracellular loops (ECL1: 81–95, ECL2: 173–243). All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe Myc or FLAG/mCherry tags fused to the N-terminus of the full-length ORF. Because the ORAI3 N-terminus is intracellular, these are cytoplasmic tags — they do not place any epitope on the extracellular face. The C-terminus is likewise intracellular. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 or ECL2, nor any other extracellular-facing position. Accordingly, zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: Myc tag fused to the N-terminus of full-length ORAI3 (pCMV-myc); the N-terminus (residues 1–64) is intracellular, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
Myc-epitope tagged ORAI3 in IRES-GFP bicistronic vector; same N-terminal intracellular placement as L1 — not an extracellular surface tag.

FLAG-mCherry tag on full-length Orai3 via mCherry-Red-p3XFLAG vector (NotI 5′/SalI 3′ cloning); tag is at the N-terminus, which is intracellular (residues 1–64); even a C-terminal placement would be intracellular (residues 265–295).
